definitions.explanation: Something that offers good value for money, or the state of getting more than expected for what you pay.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{得|とく}だ。
examples.english: This set is a good deal.

examples.japanese: ⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧お{得|とく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It becomes more economical if you buy in bulk.

examples.japanese: お{得|とく}な⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I was told about a good deal.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
お (polite prefix) + ⟦{得|とく}→得：12563_toku⟧ (profit, benefit) - polite form of ⟦{得|とく}→得：12563_toku⟧.

USAGE:
Very common in:
- Advertising and promotions
- Shopping contexts
- Discussing value/prices

COMPOUNDS:
- お{得|とく}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ - bargain information
- お{得|とく}⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ - feeling of getting a good deal
- お{得|とく}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ - bargain price
- お{得|とく}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧ - value set

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{得|とく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ - to buy at a good price
- お{得|とく}な⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧ - bargain product
